summary: Chunk 2 (units 38-74): 0 errors, 49 minor issues (41 with machine patches). The draft is careful and honest: the damaged units (44-48, 50, 51, 66, 67) are unsplit/unclear, flagged and marked 'on a conjectural reading', none invented. Main recurring faults: typo conjectures (54 svedaḥ, 61 balī, 47 mūtrāghāta) adopted silently in the translations; 'completes' in GROUPING notes; small imports (colic, return, flow, carefully, भी, वाला, बहुत मात्रा में). No plant identification is wrong: bilva = Aegle marmelos (standard, correct); śyāmā disputed and kept out of the translation. Human decisions: 46 sama/viṣama, 52 niḥśeṣa case, 55 utkṣipta case, 59 netre, 62 whether to show śyāmā in the English, 66 sarti pain vs flow, 68 bhāvayati rendering, 71 galapīḍā pressing vs pain. No regrouping needed; sentences running across units (37-40, 41-44, 45-46, 47-49, 50-51, 52-54, 55-57, 58-59, 60-61, 65-67, 68-69, 70-71, 72-74) are already noted.
